title: Optional demo data for exploring before going live
description: A new club should be able to look around before committing its own data. Offer 'Explore with demo data' during setup: a fictional club in a fictional division set with invented players, availability, selections and a few results, clearly bannered as a demo, and removable in one action that returns the instance to the setup step with the administrator account kept.

recommended_model.name: Sonnet 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Seed data and a guarded load/clear action.

acceptance_criteria: Setup offers real setup or demo data; demo data uses obviously fictional names
Every page shows a 'Demo data' banner while it is loaded
'Clear demo data' removes all of it in one transaction and returns to club selection, keeping the administrator
Demo data can never be loaded into an instance that already has real data

notes: Reuse the shape of tests/e2e/fixtures/seed.sql but with invented names - never real members.

testing_requirements: e2e: load demo, browse, clear, land back on club selection

context.user_story: As a prospective club, I want to try the app with sample data so that I can decide whether it suits us.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
